hooks.name: Test generation assistance
hooks.description: When a new backend service or API module is created, prompt the agent to add the matching tests.

action.prompt: A new backend service or API module was just created. Before calling this work complete: (1) identify its public functions or endpoints; (2) list the tests it needs per .kiro/steering/testing.md: unit tests, a Hypothesis property test for any normalizer or invariant, an integration test against real Postgres for any endpoint, and a cross-organization 404 test for any tenant-owned resource; (3) write those tests under backend/tests (or delegate to the test-engineer agent) and run them. Do not mark the related spec task done until they pass.
